name: JEI
description: Just Enough Items: the item and recipe list.

pages.title: JEI
pages.text:
**JEI**, Just Enough Items, lists every item and recipe beside your inventory. Hover an item and press **R** for how to make it, **U** for what it is used in, **A** to bookmark it.\
\
Machine recipes such as mixing, pressing and fan processing show there too. When this book says "check JEI", this is it.
